nested.help: Optional. Only actions sent on this channel (free text, e.g. new-lead) — several scenarios can listen to different automations of one board.

name: verifySignature
label: Verify signature
help: Accept only deliveries signed by Bines OS with this webhook's secret (HMAC-SHA256).
